name: Value HR Co.,Ltd.
summary: Value HR Co.,Ltd. provides health management services and health insurance services in Japan. It operates through Value Cafeteria Business and HR management Business segments. The company offers ICT interviews; and Value Cafeteria, a system for medical examination reservation, medical examination result management, specific health guidance, cafeteria, etc. It also provides welfare, healthcare, health checkup result management system, and checkup reservation systems; business development and entrepreneurship support; and invests in other venture businesses. Value HR Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
